title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin trades at $64,613 with a modest 0.8 percent gain, holding ground while fear and greed sits at 25 in extreme fear territory. Network strength stands out with hashrate at 899 EH/s and mempool backlog at 101,000 transactions carrying a lean five sat per vbyte fee. Block height now sits at 961,279. 

Traders should watch for any relief bounce as Asia opens and whether volume picks up to confirm follow-through above the current range.
